name: video
description: Videos your agent understands, on your computer: their captions read as a timed transcript (YouTube's, a .vtt or .srt, or a file's own), the speech transcribed with faster-whisper when there are none, frames where the screen changes to see slides and code, and WebVTT subtitles ready to upload to Moodle with the video.

work_folder.title: Work folder
work_folder.description: Where downloads, transcripts and frames go, a folder per video. Empty: the extension's own data folder.

whisper_model.title: Transcription model
whisper_model.description: faster-whisper's model size: bigger is better and slower. small suits a laptop's CPU.

language.title: Usual language
language.description: The language your videos are usually in (es, en…), for captions and transcription. Empty: detected for each video.

python.title: Python with faster-whisper
python.description: The Python that has faster-whisper, when it isn't the one on your PATH (a virtual environment's python). Empty: found on the PATH.

description.es: Vídeos que tu agente entiende, en tu ordenador: sus subtítulos leídos como una transcripción con tiempos (los de YouTube, un .vtt o .srt, o los del propio archivo), el habla transcrita con faster-whisper cuando no los tiene, fotogramas donde cambia la pantalla para ver diapositivas y código, y subtítulos WebVTT listos para subir a Moodle con el vídeo.

en.label: A video's captions
en.description: The subtitles a video already has, read as a timed transcript: YouTube's, a .vtt or .srt file, or a video file's own; and which videos have none.

es.label: Los subtítulos de un vídeo
es.description: Los subtítulos que ya tiene un vídeo, leídos como una transcripción con tiempos: los de YouTube, un archivo .vtt o .srt, o los del propio archivo de vídeo; y qué vídeos no tienen.

en.label: Transcribing a video
en.description: What's said in a video without subtitles, as text with its times, transcribed on your computer with faster-whisper.

es.label: Transcribir un vídeo
es.description: Lo que se dice en un vídeo sin subtítulos, como texto con sus tiempos, transcrito en tu ordenador con faster-whisper.

en.label: What a video shows
en.description: Frames where the screen changes (a new slide, another window, code written), each with its time, for the agent to look at alongside what's said.

es.label: Lo que muestra un vídeo
es.description: Fotogramas donde cambia la pantalla (una diapositiva nueva, otra ventana, código escrito), cada uno con su tiempo, para que el agente los mire junto a lo que se dice.

en.label: YouTube and online videos
en.description: A YouTube video, or another site's, by its address: its details and captions read, and its audio or picture downloaded to transcribe it or see it.

es.label: YouTube y vídeos en línea
es.description: Un vídeo de YouTube, o de otro sitio, por su dirección: sus datos y subtítulos leídos, y su audio o su imagen descargados para transcribirlo o verlo.

en.label: Subtitles for a video
en.description: A WebVTT subtitle file made from a transcription and corrected with you, ready to upload to Moodle with the video.

es.label: Subtítulos para un vídeo
es.description: Un archivo de subtítulos WebVTT hecho a partir de una transcripción y corregido contigo, listo para subirlo a Moodle con el vídeo.

install.macos: python3 -m venv ~/.video-mcp-python && ~/.video-mcp-python/bin/pip install faster-whisper (then set the Python setting to ~/.video-mcp-python/bin/python)
install.linux: python3 -m venv ~/.video-mcp-python && ~/.video-mcp-python/bin/pip install faster-whisper (then set the Python setting to ~/.video-mcp-python/bin/python)

agent-kit.help: Video: I read what a video says from its captions (YouTube's, a .vtt or .srt, or a file's own), transcribe it on this computer with faster-whisper when it has none, take frames where the screen changes to see slides and code, and write WebVTT subtitles for a video, corrected with the person. My skills video:video-understanding and video:video-subtitles hold how. It runs ffmpeg, faster-whisper and yt-dlp, which the person installs; check_requirements says what's missing and how to install it.
